# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# One good at a time, and a right is the other answer to the same question --
# so setting either clears the other. `bag_wtp_good_index` is what the ranking
# pass reads; `_sel<n>` is what the circle in the window draws itself from.
#
# The `root`s that used to be here are gone with the CMM callbacks that made
# them safe: every effect below is called from a scripted GUI in the country's
# own scope.

# Every good's circle off. One press writes one on again.
# Scope: country

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_sync_sel = {
	bag_wtp_clear_good_sel = yes
	bag_wtp_clear_right_sel = yes
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sel1 value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sel2 value = 1 } }

# clay
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_set_good_1 = {
	bag_wtp_clear_good_sel = yes
	bag_wtp_clear_right_sel = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:clay }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sel1 value = 1 }

	# A right and a good are two answers to one question.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = 0 }

	# The table on screen answered for the good before this one. Clearing it is
	# the honest state: «Искать локации» is what fills it again.
	bag_wtp_clear_rows = yes
}
